reason: In scripts/test-gcal-webhooks.sh:561-564, when `pgrep -f "tmole 3000"` finds a tmole process, the script only greps /tmp/tmole.log for the URL. It never checks that this script created that log, so a tmole started by hand or with other output leaves the file missing and TUNNEL_URL empty, which hits the "Failed to extract Tunnelmole URL" exit at lines 589-591. A leftover log from an earlier session can also give an old URL.
